{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Meteora; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic heaviness fits, but I am choosing heavier albums this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: St. Anger Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its raw, clattering sound is less appealing right now than the layered heaviness of my recent listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Iowa Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The intense riffs and aggression fit my interest in Disturbed and heavier metal.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ashes Of The Wake Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The tight grooves and technical riffs feel like a strong match for my In Flames and Soilwork listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hybrid Theory; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic hooks fit my rock tastes, but it is less compelling than the heavier choices today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The War Within; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The combination of thrash riffs, melody, and aggression connects closely with my interest in Advance And Vanquish.
ItemID: NA; Title: Vulgar Display of Power Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy grooves appeal, but I would try Ashes Of The Wake first this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: War on Errorism; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its punk sound is outside the heavier, more layered metal mood I am in today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Follow The Leader Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The dark grooves fit some of my taste, but I currently want more intricate guitar work.
ItemID: NA; Title: Chaos A.D.; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its rhythmic heaviness interests me, but I already have three stronger picks for this visit."}
